system.description: Dabbler Base 6.3 - Mechanisms. Spells to analyze and tune machines, jam mechanisms, pick locks and disarm traps, operate non-magical machines remotely, and detect active magic in the area, culminating in Operate True. Special Notes: 1) For the purposes of spells on this list, a machine is any manmade device built to perform a specific function. 2) Each lock and trap is rated according to the difficulty in unlocking/disarming it. The standard difficulty modifiers apply: Routine (+30), Easy (+20), Light (+10), Medium (0), Hard (-10), Very Hard (-20), Extremely Hard (-30), Sheer Folly (-50), Absurd (at least -70). Some suggested difficulty modifiers are: Simple Shackle Lock (Easy), Padlock (Medium to Hard), Tumbler Lock (Hard to Extremely Hard), Double Key Tumbler (Sheer Folly). If a spell (e.g., Opening I, Disarm I, etc.) is used to attempt to unlock/disarm a device, the chance of the spell successfully operating the lock is modified by half of the modifier given above.

This spell analyzes one "machine," giving the caster an idea of its purpose and operating procedures. This gives the caster a special bonus of +20 when operating this particular machine, and +10 to anyone to whom he describes the machine.

When this spell is cast upon a machine, the machine's efficiency will return to its original level. For example, if cast upon a rusty lock, the lock will return to its original non-rusty operational level.

This spell has a 50% chance of jamming the target mechanism (e.g., trap, lock, machine, etc.). If it is jammed, there is only a 5% chance that the target mechanism operates normally when used/triggered normally (check each time the mechanism is used). For example, if this spell is cast upon a pressure plate in the floor (that drops a portcullis), there is a 5% chance the mechanism will trigger each time someone walks over it.

This spell has a 30% chance of opening any non-magical lock. If the lock is not unlocked, there is a 10% chance that any traps associated with it are set off. Rolls are open-ended and the sophistication of the lock may modify the roll.
As Unlock I, except its concerns disarming traps. There is a 10% chance the trap being disarmed is set off.

As Unlock I, except this spell has a 30% chance of operating any non-magical machine in its normal capacity for the duration of the spell. After the duration, the machine will operate normally. For example, if this spell were used to turn a wheel, the wheel would spin for the duration of the spell, then slowly stop.

For the duration of this spell, the caster will be aware when any active magic is in the area of effect. The caster will not know what the magic is or where it is; only that it is in the area of effect. For example, a Dabbler with this spell active can move down a passageway. The moment he gets near magical symbols on a door, he will be warned of active magic in the area (and perhaps the spell casters in the party can set out to find the source).
As Jam I, except has a 70% chance of jamming the mechanism (and only a 4% chance of setting it off).
As Unlock I, except has a 50% chance of opening the lock (and only an 8% chance of setting off associated traps).
As Untrap I, except has a 50% chance of disarming the trap (8% chance of setting off the trap).
As Operate I, except has a 50% chance of operating the machine.
As Jam I, except has a 90% chance of jamming the trap (and only a 3% chance of setting it off).
As Unlock I, except has a 70% chance of opening the lock (and only a 6% chance of setting off associated traps).
As Untrap I, except has a 70% chance of disarming the trap (and a 6% chance of setting off the trap).
As Operate I, except has a 70% chance of operating the machine.
As Jam I, except has a 100% chance of jamming the trap (and only a 2% chance of setting it off).
As Unlock I, except has a 90% chance of opening the lock (and only a 4% chance of setting off the trap).
As Untrap I, except has a 70% chance of disarming the trap (and a 4% chance of setting it off).
As Operate I, except has a 90% chance of operating the machine.
As Jam III, except affects all traps in the area of effect.
As Unlock III, except affects all locks in the area of effect.
As Untrap III, except affects all traps in the area of effect.
As Operate III, except affects all machines in the area of effect.
